title: Kagamine Len — Gifts Give Form To Feelings〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: Memories That Come With The Scent of Candles

rows.Line: Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I had another look at the candles you made, Len. You really did a wonderful job.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, and the flowers in them are very cute...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: R-Really...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Still, I don't think any of us were expecting you to make such nice Valentine's Day gifts for us.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Kanade helped you make them, right...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Y-Yeah... She came to talk to me after becoming a little worried about how I was doing...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Then, after I told her that I wanted to make some gifts, she suggested that we make some candles since she had some supplies left over...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad you had a chance to make them, Len.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Me too...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
So, it smells nice as it is...
But since it's a candle, why don't we try lighting it?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, Kanade gave me some matches... But... I'm not sure how to light them...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I'll do it...
Where are they?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
...!
Thanks! I'll go get them now!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Someone's feeling generous today.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: This hardly counts as being generous.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wow...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It's lit...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I love how the flame sort of dances. I could watch this endlessly.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, I'm starting to smell something...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Me too...
It smells refreshingly sweet.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
*Sniff*
Hey, you're right...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Mind if I take a whiff?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I could've just carried it over...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hm? This works just fine...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I agree.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Join us, Miku.
You probably can't smell it from over there.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: How is it, Miku...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's such a gentle fragrance. I like it...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
(Thank goodness...!
They really like how it smells.)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (I'm so glad I asked Kanade how to make these...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: What about you, Len?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, right.
I haven't actually tried smelling it yet...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, because Kanade was the one who actually made them...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Then, don't stand over there.
Come here and join in on the fun.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
(Oh, it smells like apples...
I think Kanade said this is chamomile.)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (I feel so much warmth welling up inside of me...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (I hope the others are also feeling the same way...)
